Package io.mavlink4j.codec

Record Class SignatureRejection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.mavlink4j.codec.SignatureRejection
public record SignatureRejection(LinkId link, SysId system, CompId component, int messageId, SignatureStatus status, SignatureRejection.Reason reason, int sequence, LinkPeer source, Instant receivedAt) extends Record
A frame FrameReader decoded but did not dispatch, because SignatureVerifier itself refused it or because SigningPolicy.accept(int, SignatureStatus) did, given a verifier result it chose not to accept. Reported via io.mavlink4j.session.MavlinkSession#onFrameRejected -- never thrown, never logged above DEBUG (a storm of bad frames must not flood the log at WARNING).

sequence, source and receivedAt are the link-layer facts of the datagram: the session counts the sequence for link health even though the frame was refused (a policy drop is not radio loss), and a consumer can tell which address an unsigned sender used.

Thread-safety: Immutable and thread-safe; delivered on the receive thread, so a listener must not block.
